subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

__Many a women work for__ the betterment of their family.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Many a"** is used with a singular noun and a singular verb to emphasize the large number of something. (अनेक)

 
 
• **Example:** Many a student has benefited from this scholarship program.
 
 
 
• **"Woman"** refers to an adult female human. (महिला)
 
 
• **Example:** The woman at the counter was very helpful.
 
 
 
• Hence, **"Many a woman" **is the** correct phrase** to use, and it should be followed by the singular verb "works".

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***"Many a woman works for".***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Many a women works for** (अनेक महिलाएं काम करती हैं): This is incorrect because "Many a" should be followed by a singular noun and verb.

 
 
• **Example:** Many a women works for the betterment of their family. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Many a women working for** (अनेक महिलाएं काम कर रही हैं): This is incorrect because it uses the plural noun "women" and changes the verb form.
 
 
• **Example:** Many a women working for the betterment of their family. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Many a woman worked for** (अनेक महिलाओं ने काम किया): This is incorrect because it uses the past tense "worked".
 
 
• **Example:** Many a woman worked for the betterment of their family. (Incorrect)
 
 

 

3f:Tc61,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
